BJP legislators sing full Vande Mataram in Karnataka Assembly

BJP legislators in the Karnataka Assembly and Council recited the full version of the national song 'Vande Mataram' during a session. This action defied a state order that stipulated the song be sung for only two stanzas. The BJP members persisted with their slogans, creating a chaotic atmosphere, with some holding placards. The session began with a renewed demand for statehood restoration in Jammu and Kashmir, where the Speaker urged BJP MLAs to take their seats.
